mail.subject: Air freight quote FRA to JFK
mail.body:
Hello, please quote 2 pallets, 340 kg, FRA to JFK. Packing list attached.
Anna

why: Customers attach packing lists and commercial invoices to requests.

mail.subject: Request for quotation
mail.body: Please see the attached cargo details and quote MUC to SIN, 1250 kg, fastest.

why: Shipment details in a spreadsheet are common.

mail.subject: Quote please
mail.body: FRA-ORD, 1 crate, 85 kg. Photo of the crate attached.

why: A photo of the goods is an attachment, not a tariff.

mail.subject: Booking request FRA-JFK, dimensions confirmed
mail.body: Hi, we would like a price for 300 kg FRA to JFK, dims confirmed by the warehouse.

why: A new customer request can use the words booking and confirmed.

mail.subject: Air freight
mail.body: Could you quote air freight from Munich to Shanghai for three pallets? Weight follows.

why: No code or digit: the rules cannot place it; the model or the new-thread default must.

mail.subject: quote
mail.body: fra to jfk, 300 kilos, cheapest pls

mail.subject: Shipping request
mail.body: We need to ship 450 kg to Chicago next week, what would it cost?

why: A weight alone marks a request.

mail.subject: Skyway Cargo tariff December 2026
mail.body: Dear partner, please find our December tariff attached.

why: After a change a new airline can send its first tariff.

mail.subject: Rate FRA-JFK
mail.body: Hello, for FRA-JFK 340 kg we offer EUR 1.95/kg all-in, transit 3 days.

why: A carrier may answer without replying in our thread.

mail.subject: Re: Rate request FRA-JFK
mail.body: Please find our offer attached: EUR 1.95/kg all-in, 3 days.

why: An offer as a PDF in the bid thread is still a bid.

mail.subject: Re: Air freight quote FRA to JFK
mail.body: Hi, my colleague Anna is out, we accept your offer, please book.

why: Another person of the same customer answers the quote.

mail.subject: Confirmation of booking BK-9F8E7D6C
mail.body: We confirm booking BK-9F8E7D6C, your reference PX-1A2B3C.

why: The API names the subject 'Booking <reference> confirmed'; a changed wording would still be a confirmation.

mail.subject: Rate FRA-JFK
mail.body: For FRA-JFK 340 kg we offer EUR 1.95/kg all-in, transit 3 days.

why: If the API ever sends a display name with the address, the carrier list must still match.
